# Lines

*Describes silverpoint 0.7.0.*

4 charts. Shared props, the data shapes and the recommender are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md).

**Contents:** [LineChart](#linechart) · [StepChart](#stepchart) · [SparklineRows](#sparklinerows) · [KpiCard](#kpicard)

## LineChart

`line-chart` · Spline with an optional dotted baseline series.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `LineChart` | `SpLineChart` | `sp-line-chart` | `line_chart` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/line-chart` | `@silverpoint/vue/line-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/line-chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `series`; intents `trend`, `change`, `compare`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| x | `xKey` | string | yes |
| value | `valueKey` | number | yes |
| secondary | `secondaryKey` | number | no |

The demo's first rows (read through xKey="hour", valueKey="hits", secondaryKey="baseline"), drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "hour": "00", "hits": 18, "baseline": 22 }, { "hour": "02", "hits": 14, "baseline": 18 }, { "hour": "04", "hits": 11, "baseline": 15 } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `xKey` | `Accessor<string \| number>` | `'x'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `valueKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'value'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `secondaryKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` |  | Ignored without `data`. |
| `curve` | `LineCurve` | `'monotone'` |  |
| `series` | `'all' \| 'primary'` | `'all'` | `all` draws the secondary series when there is one; `primary` omits it. |
| `connectNulls` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether a gap left by a missing value is bridged (REQ-008). |

### Example

```tsx
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import { LineChart } from '@silverpoint/react/line-chart';

export function LineChartView({ rows }: { rows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] }) {
  return (
    <LineChart
      data={rows}
      xKey="hour"
      valueKey="hits"
      secondaryKey="baseline"
      title="Line chart"
    />
  );
}
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import { SpLineChart } from '@silverpoint/vue/line-chart';

defineProps<{ rows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] }>();
</script>

<template>
  <SpLineChart
    :data="rows"
    xKey="hour"
    valueKey="hits"
    secondaryKey="baseline"
    title="Line chart"
  />
</template>
```

```ts angular
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, input } from '@angular/core';
import { SpLineChart } from '@silverpoint/angular/line-chart';

/** Add '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css', '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css' to the `styles` of angular.json. */
@Component({
  selector: 'app-line-chart-view',
  imports: [SpLineChart],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <sp-line-chart
      [data]="rows()"
      [xKey]="'hour'"
      [valueKey]="'hits'"
      [secondaryKey]="'baseline'"
      [title]="'Line chart'"
    />
  `,
})
export class LineChartView {
  readonly rows = input.required<readonly Record<string, unknown>[]>();
}
```

## StepChart

`step-chart` · A series drawn as steps.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `StepChart` | `SpStepChart` | `sp-step-chart` | `step_chart` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/step-chart` | `@silverpoint/vue/step-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/step-chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `series`; intents `trend`, `change`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| x | `xKey` | string | yes |
| value | `valueKey` | number | yes |

The demo's first rows, drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "x": "Jan", "value": 12 }, { "x": "Feb", "value": 12 }, { "x": "Mar", "value": 18 } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `xKey` | `Accessor<string \| number>` | `'x'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `valueKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'value'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `step` | `'after' \| 'before' \| 'middle'` | `'after'` | Where the step sits between two points; `after` by default. |

## SparklineRows

`sparkline-rows` · One row per series — name, sparkline, readout.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `SparklineRows` | `SpSparklineRows` | `sp-sparkline-rows` | `sparkline_rows` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/sparkline-rows` | `@silverpoint/vue/sparkline-rows` | `@silverpoint/angular/sparkline-rows` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `series`; intents `trend`, `compare`, `kpi`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| name | `nameKey` | string | yes |
| points | `seriesKey` | array | yes |
| point | `pointKey` | number | no |
| readout | `readoutKey` | string | no |

The demo's first rows, drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "name": "API", "readout": "99.9%", "points": [ 98, 99, 99, 97, 99, 100, 99, 100 ] }, { "name": "Queue", "points": [ 12, 18, 15, 22, 19, 25, 21, 17 ] }, { "name": "Cache", "readout": "84%", "points": [ 70, 72, 78, 75, 80, 83, 81, 84 ] } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rows` | `number` |  | Rows shown, from the first; all by default. |
| `nameKey` | `Accessor<string>` | `'name'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `readoutKey` | `Accessor<string \| number \| null \| undefined>` | `'readout'` | The printed readout; the last value of the series by default. Ignored without `data`. |
| `seriesKey` | `Accessor<readonly unknown[] \| null \| undefined>` | `'points'` | The row's points: an array. Ignored without `data`. |
| `pointKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` |  | The value of one point; the point itself when it is a number, else its `value`. Ignored without `data`. |

### Example

```tsx
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import { SparklineRows } from '@silverpoint/react/sparkline-rows';

export function SparklineRowsView({ rows }: { rows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] }) {
  return (
    <SparklineRows
      data={rows}
      nameKey="name"
      seriesKey="points"
      title="Sparkline rows"
    />
  );
}
```

## KpiCard

`kpi-card` · A metric, its delta, and an area sparkline of the series.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `KpiCard` | `SpKpiCard` | `sp-kpi-card` | `kpi_card` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/kpi-card` | `@silverpoint/vue/kpi-card` | `@silverpoint/angular/kpi-card` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `single`; intents `kpi`, `change`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| value | `valueKey` | number | yes |

The demo's first rows, drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "value": 118 }, { "value": 124 }, { "value": 121 } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `valueKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'value'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `metric` | `string` |  | The metric's name, printed under the figure. |
| `delta` | `number` |  | Signed change, printed with its sign and a direction mark. |
| `deltaTone` | `'up' \| 'down' \| 'flat'` | `delta` | Direction of the mark; from the sign of `delta` by default. |

### Example

```tsx
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';

export function KpiCardView({ rows }: { rows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] }) {

      valueKey="value"
      title="Kpi card"

}
```
